heading: Land-grant colleges constituted depositories
lead: Land-grant colleges are constituted depositories to receive Government publications subject to the depository laws.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Based on 44 U.S. Code, 1964 ed., § 85 (part) (Mar. 1, 1907, ch. 2284, § 4, 34 Stat. 1014; June 25, 1938, ch. 708, 52 Stat. 1206; Aug. 9, 1962, Pub. L. 87–579, 76 Stat. 354). This section is from the last paragraph of former section 85; the remainder of that section will be found in section 1903 of the revision.
